subject: DI02000161

body.en:
Understand the idea

The source groups combinational circuits into arithmetic/logical and data-transmission functions.

Explanation and application

  • Arithmetic group:adders and subtractors with sum/carry or difference/borrow outputs.
  • Data-transmission group:MUX/DEMUXselect or distribute data;encoders/decoders transform line/code representations.
  • All these ideal core models have no intended stored state;real propagation delay is not an extra flip-flop.
Half versus full adder?

Ahalf adder has two operand inputs;afull adder includes carry-in.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Sourceમાં combinationalcircuitsને arithmetic/logicalતથા data-transmissionfunctionsમાંgroupકર્યાંછે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Arithmeticgroupમાંadders/subtractorsતથાsum/carryકેdifference/borrowoutputsછે.
  • Data-transmissiongroupમાંMUX/DEMUXdataselect/distributeકરે;encoders/decodersline/code representationsફેરવે છે.
  • આidealcoremodelsમાંintendedstoredstateનથી.Realpropagationdelayવધારાનોflip-flopનથી.
Half સામે Full Adder?

Halfadderમાંબેoperandinputs;fulladderમાંcarry-inપણછે.

Understand the idea

Adds two1-bit operands without a carry input.

Construction and application

  • An XOR produces the sum and an AND produces carry from the same A,Bnets.
  • The two outputs represent a two-bit result2C+S;they must not be shorted together.
  • Useful at the least-significant addition stage.
  • Cannot accept a carry from a previous stage.

Working:signal path

  1. For00no bit is set;for01or10the XOR gives sum1with carry0.
  2. For11,the numeric sum2is binary10:sum0,carry1.

Output equations

S=(A ⊕ B)

C=(A · B)

Construction તથા ઉપયોગ

  • એ જ A,Bnets પરથી XOR sumઅને AND carry આપે છે.

  • Least-significant addition stageમાં ઉપયોગી.
  • Previous stageનો carry લઈ શકતું નથી.

  2. 11માં numeric sum2અર્થાત્ binary10;sum0,carry1.

Understand the idea

Adds A,B and carry-in to produce sum and carry-out.

Construction and application

  • First half-adder forms P=A⊕B and G=AB;second adds Cin to P.
  • OR combines G with P·Cin;the shared Pnet feeds both sum and carry paths.
  • Used in multi-bit addition.
  • Carry-out is not by itself the signed-overflow flag.

Working:signal path

  1. Sum is odd parity of the three inputs;carry is1when at least two inputs are1.
  2. For111,total3=11₂,so S=1,Cout=1.Cascading stages forms a ripple-carry adder with accumulated delay.

Output equations

S=((A ⊕ B) ⊕ Cin)

Cout=((A · B) + (Cin · (A ⊕ B)))

A,B તથા carry-in ઉમેરી sum/carry-out આપે છે.

Construction તથા ઉપયોગ

  • First half-adder P=A⊕Bઅને G=ABબનાવે;બીજું Pમાં Cinઉમેરે.
  • ORથી Gઅને P·Cinભેગાં થાય;shared Pnet sum/carryબંને pathsમાં જાય.
  • Multi-bit additionમાં ઉપયોગી.
  • Carry-out એકલો signed-overflow flag નથી.

  1. Sum ત્રણ inputsની odd parity છે;ઓછામાં ઓછા બે inputs1હોય તો carry1.
  2. 111માં total3=11₂,તેથી S=1,Cout=1.Stages cascade કરતાં ripple-carry adder બને છે;delay ઉમેરાય છે.

Understand the idea

Subtracts B from A without borrow-in.

Construction and application

  • XOR generates difference;NOT on A and AND with B generate borrow.
  • A is the minuend,B the subtrahend;reversing their roles changes borrow.
  • Useful for the first subtraction stage.
  • No provision for incoming borrow.

Working:signal path

  1. At A=0,B=1,borrow from the next position supplies2,leaving difference1.
  2. At11,difference0and borrow0;check A−B=D−2Borrow on every row.

Output equations

D=(A ⊕ B)

Borrow=((A)′ · B)

વિચાર સમજીએ

Borrow-in વગર Aમાંથી Bબાદ કરે છે.

Construction તથા ઉપયોગ

  • XOR difference આપે;Aનું NOT અને Bસાથે ANDથી borrow મળે.
  • A minuend અને B subtrahend છે;roles બદલવાથી borrow બદલાય.
  • પ્રથમ subtraction stageમાં ઉપયોગી.
  • Incoming borrowની સુવિધા નથી.

  1. A=0,B=1માં આગળની positionમાંથી borrowથી2મળે;difference1રહે.
  2. 11માં difference0અને borrow0;દરેક rowમાં A−B=D−2Borrowતપાસો.

Understand the idea

Subtracts B and Bin from A.

Construction and application

  • Two half-subtractor paths form P=A⊕B and D=P⊕Bin.
  • OR combines A′B with P′Bin to generate outgoing borrow.
  • Used in multi-bit subtraction.
  • Do not confuse borrow polarity with adder carry polarity.

Working:signal path

  1. At A=0,B=1,Bin=1,the value−2is represented by D=0,Bout=1.
  2. Check A−B−Bin=D−2Bout for all eight rows.Connect Bout to the next more-significant stage Bin.

Output equations

D=((A ⊕ B) ⊕ Bin)

Bout=(((A)′ · B) + (((A ⊕ B))′ · Bin))

Construction તથા ઉપયોગ

  • બે half-subtractor paths P=A⊕Bઅને D=P⊕Binબનાવે છે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

A data selector routes one of the data inputs to a single output.

Construction and application

  • The selector needs nselect lines for2^ninputs;each data line is ANDed with its unique select minterm,then all paths are ORed.
  • Input labels D0…Dn are data;Slabels are addresses.They must not be interchanged in the pin map.
  • Applications:data routing,time-shared measurement and Boolean function generation.
  • Select changes may create transient glitches;not an analog power switch.

Working:signal path

  1. Decode the select word with the highest-index Sbit as MSB.Only its product term is enabled;the other product terms are0.
  2. The selected Dvalue passes to Y,whether it is0or1.Changing an unselected data bit does not change ideal Y.
  3. An actual IC may supply inverted and noninverted outputs or a strobe;verify those independently rather than copying the ideal model.

Output equations

Y=(((S0)′ · D0) + (S0 · D1))

Functional block diagram

Truth / reference table

Select bitsY
0D0
1D1

Selection relation is complete for arbitrary data bits;enable assumed active.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Data selector અનેક data inputsમાંથી એકને single output સુધી પહોંચાડે છે.

Construction તથા ઉપયોગ

  • 2^ninputs માટે nselect lines જોઈએ.દરેક data lineને unique select mintermથી AND કરીને pathsનું ORલો.
  • D0…Dn data છે;Slabels addresses છે.Pin mapમાં બંને બદલી ન નાખો.
  • ઉપયોગ:data routing,time-shared measurement તથા Boolean function generation.
  • Select changeથી transient glitches થઈ શકે;આ analog power switch નથી.

Working:Signal Path

  1. Highest-index Sbitને MSBલઈ select word decode કરો.એનો product term જ enabled છે;બીજા terms0છે.
  2. Selected Dની0/1value Yપર આવે.Unselected data bit બદલવાથી ideal Yબદલાતો નથી.
  3. Actual ICમાં inverted/noninverted outputs અથવા strobe હોઈ શકે;ideal modelની નકલ કરવાને બદલે અલગ verify કરો.

Output Equations

Y=(((S0)′ · D0) + (S0 · D1))

Functional Block Diagram

Truth / Reference Table

Select bitsY
0D0
1D1

કોઈપણ data bits માટે selection relation પૂર્ણ છે;enable active માનેલું છે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

A data distributor routes a single input D to one selected output;unselected active-high outputs remain0.

Construction and application

  • Generate a select minterm for each output and AND it with D.There is no final OR combining the outputs.
  • Use one or more select inputs according to output count.The logic diagram assumes active-high outputs.
  • Applications:addressed indicators and data distribution.
  • Never connect output pins together to create one combined line.

Working:signal path

  1. When D=0,all ideal outputs are0.When D=1,exactly the addressed output is1.
  2. A decoder with enable can act as a demultiplexer,provided the enable/data and output polarity are interpreted correctly.
  3. For a74LS138 implementation,selected output isLOW when enabled;its active-low outputs are not the same table as this active-high model.

Output equations

Y0=(D · (S0)′)

Y1=(D · S0)

Functional block diagram

Truth / reference table

DS0Y0Y1
0000
0100
1010
1101

Expected logic values;not measured observations.

વિચાર સમજીએ

Data distributor એક Dinputને selected outputપર મોકલે;બીજા active-high outputs0રહે છે.

Construction તથા ઉપયોગ

  • દરેક output માટે select minterm બનાવી Dસાથે AND કરો.Outputsને ભેગાં કરતું final ORનથી.
  • Output count પ્રમાણે select inputs લો.Logic diagram active-high outputs માને છે.
  • ઉપયોગ:addressed indicators તથા data distribution.
  • Output pins ભેગાં જોડીને combined line ન બનાવો.

Working:Signal Path

  1. D=0માં બધા ideal outputs0;D=1માં addressed output જ1હોય છે.
  2. Enableવાળો decoder demultiplexer બની શકે,પણ enable/data તથા output polarity યોગ્ય interpret કરવી પડે.

Understand the idea

A four-bit BCD digit determines which of seven segments form a decimal numeral.

Explanation and application

  • Segments a,b,c,d,e,f,g are independent loads;provide one current-limiting resistor per segment,not one shared resistor for the entire display.
  • Common-anode displays use a common positive terminal and low-side segment current;common-cathode displays use the opposite arrangement.Driver polarity must match the display.
  • 7447family is intended for common-anode drive;check open-collector behaviour,pull/current path and LT/blanking/ripple-blanking controls in the exact datasheet.Do not short outputs to the supply.
  • BCD1010through1111are not decimal digits.Do not claim every decoder blanks them;actual response depends on device/control inputs.
  • Working:decode each BCD value into seven output functions,drive the selected segment currents,then inspect the glyph.LED illumination alone does not prove correct voltage/current margins.

title.en: Practical.11 Build and test Half Adder

body.en:
Aim

Verify both outputs and the arithmetic identity on every row.

Instruments and preparation

  • Use the approved low-voltage current-limited trainer,verified logic ICs/breadboard,defined input switches,logic probe or high-impedance meter,and exact device datasheet.A simulated/numerical practical needs its stated tools instead.
  • Check package orientation and recommended VCCbefore connecting.Power OFFfor wiring;do not apply a9Vbattery directly to74LSlogic;trainer0–30Vcapability is not an IC operating rating.

Circuit connections / setup

Wire the numbered gate paths from the logic diagram;for FA/FSprobe the shared first XORnode before connecting the second stage.

Procedure

  1. Derive the expected table first;declare bit order,active polarity and any enable/clock assumptions.
  2. Inspect the unpowered connections against the labelled logic diagram and approved pin map;verify common ground and a suitable local decoupling capacitor.
  3. Test all4rows for HA/HSand all8rows for FA/FS.Include the carry/borrow input rather than leaving it floating.
  4. Read each output after settling;for sequential circuits record current state,command,clock event and next state separately.
  5. On a mismatch,stop and trace supply,input definition,polarity and intermediate nodes;power OFFbefore changing wiring.
  6. Save genuine results and explain each discrepancy;power down safely.Do not fill actual observations with expected numbers or claim an unperformed experiment.

Expected calculations and interpretation

Check A+B(+Cin)=S+2Cout for adders;A−B(−Bin)=D−2Bout for subtractors.

Fault finding

A correct difference/sum does not prove the borrow/carry network is correct;probe both outputs.

Precautions

  • Never short outputs or exceed ratings;unused inputs must be defined.Output LEDloads need a checked driver/current limiter;an LEDwired to VCCmay indicate logicLOWwhen lit.
  • Use only isolated approved low-voltage apparatus;do not connect mains to logic circuits.A safe trainer is not a guarantee against reversed supply or incorrect pinout.

Actual observations:blank learner evidence
